title: Nutrien (NTR) Deep Dive Analysis
summary: Fertilizer resilience and a new speculative Bitcoin position.

evidence.finding: Weekly total assets rose from $4.183 trillion on February 12, 2020 to $4.242 trillion March 4 and $6.368 trillion April 15. A brief late-February decline preceded the surge.

claims.claim: Bitcoin offers a timely speculative holding
claims.reason: From next-day April 13 close $6871 to December 31, 2021 $46244.63, the price rose 573.04%. The stated 2020-2021 window succeeds strongly, with a 53.21% daily-close peak drawdown inside it. This is directional price evidence, not custody-adjusted investor P&L.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

claims.claim: Halving reduces issuance but raises cost
claims.reason: The issuance reduction is correct. Greater computation per coin holds other things equal; difficulty and miner participation adjust, so it is not a guaranteed permanent increase in electricity or capital cost. Prior two outcomes are a tiny sample.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Bitcoin halving and difficulty mechanics
evidence.finding: Subsidy halves every 210,000 blocks; 2020 cut 12.5 to 6.25 BTC. Difficulty retargets every 2016 blocks, so miner exit can lower difficulty. Reduced issuance is not a protocol requirement for permanently higher mining cost or market price.

claims.reason: No cash flow or industrial application does not imply no economic utility. The network-effect thesis requires adoption and security measures; price appreciation alone does not establish intrinsic value or permanence.

evidence.title: Nutrien 2020 results
evidence.finding: 2020 adjusted EBITDA fell 9% to $3.667 b; retail EBITDA rose 16%, potash EBITDA fell 25%. Free cash flow was $1.830 b versus $2.157 b. The company retained and subsequently increased its dividend; lower nutrient prices offset volume and retail growth.

framework_lessons: Match the holding window to the stated catalyst.
assessment: The explicit Bitcoin call was a major directional success with substantial interim risk. Nutrien retail and payout resilience held up, and fertilizer pricing rose strongly by 2021, although the narrower 2020 operating expectation was weaker. Halving mechanics and agricultural cycles require qualifications that investment gains cannot erase.
